title: Stable Admits He Doesn’t Know How to Land While He’s Still Flying
caption: The pilot just admitted he has no idea how to land. Listen to what he says after giving it a go. #StableRonaldo #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: If my pilot said this, I'd be texting everybody. What would you do?
why: The pilot admits he can’t land, tries anyway, then calls the attempt “Butter.”

title: Stable Tells His Passengers to Ignore the Buildings
caption: “Ignore the buildings” is a wild thing to hear from your pilot. Wait till he brings up the bridge. #StableRonaldo #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: The second he says “ignore the buildings,” I'm looking straight at the buildings.
why: The warning about the buildings makes the pilot’s repeated insistence that everything is under control funnier.

title: A Passenger Threatens to Sue Stable After His Flight
caption: A passenger says they’re suing. Stable’s response sounds like he gets this complaint every day. #StableRonaldo #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: Are you asking for a refund or calling a lawyer after this flight?
why: A passenger opens with a lawsuit threat, and Stable brushes it off with “Well, good luck.”

title: Stable Picks the Wrong Elevator and Starts Reading the Vibes
caption: Stable freaks out over picking the wrong elevator. Seconds later, he’s convinced he might be getting some play. #StableRonaldo #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: Would you ride back down or pretend that was your floor?
why: The wrong elevator sparks immediate panic before Stable pivots into wildly optimistic flirting.

title: Stable Goes From Cockpit Panic to Offering Snacks
caption: Stable keeps yelling “Oh, no!” Then comes the least urgent announcement a pilot could possibly make. #StableRonaldo #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: Honestly, I'd still take the snacks.
why: The panicked “Oh, no!” gives way to Stable cheerfully trying to get snacks delivered.

title: Stable Calls It a Great Flight Seconds After Stalling
caption: Stable calls out a stall mid-flight. Stick around for his review of how the flight went. #StableRonaldo #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: How many stars are you giving that flight?
why: The immediate stall call makes Stable’s repeated “Smooth as butter” verdict land as a punchline.
